user.title: Connect to Matinee
user.description: Home Assistant looks for Matinee on your home network by itself. If it didn't find yours, type the address you open Matinee at.

confirm.title: Matinee found
confirm.description: Connect Home Assistant to {name} at {url}? Next you'll approve it with a code, like the Matinee apps.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Matinee again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant was signed out of Matinee at {url}. Sign it in again with a code.

expired.title: The code expired
expired.description: Nobody approved the code in time. Get a new one?

progress.approve: On a phone or computer signed in to Matinee as an admin, open [{url}]({link}) and enter the code **{code}**. Home Assistant carries on by itself once you approve it.

abort.already_configured: This Matinee server is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This Matinee server is already being set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Matinee. Check the address, and that Home Assistant and Matinee are on the same network.
abort.declined: Someone declined the sign-in on the Matinee server.
abort.not_admin: That account isn't a Matinee admin. Approve the code while signed in as an admin, so Home Assistant can see and control every player.
abort.too_old: This Matinee server is too old for Home Assistant. Update Matinee, then try again.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Matinee at that address.
error.too_old: This Matinee server is too old for Home Assistant. Update Matinee, then try again.

sleep_timer.name: Sleep timer
sleep_timer.description: Stops playback after a while, or at the end of what's playing. 0 minutes turns the timer off.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Pause after this many minutes; 0 turns the timer off.

end_of_item.name: At the end
end_of_item.description: Stop when the episode or movie ends instead.

set_subtitles.name: Set subtitles
set_subtitles.description: Shows a subtitle track, or none.

track.name: Track
track.description: The track's id, as in the player's subtitles attribute; empty for none.
